entries.subject: Selected Galileo SSI reconstructed observations
entries.finding: C0532890500 and the documented complementary views supply coarse Monochrome under fixed ellipsoid registration.

entries.subject: C0401639113, C0401773600 and C0401786800 alternatives
entries.finding: C0401639113 was rejected for radiation noise. C0401773600 and C0401786800 were rejected for much coarser or redundant coverage after inspection of the original G8/C9/E11 observations.
entries.revisitWhen: A registration and level review shows distinct usable coverage.

entries.subject: PIA02531, Voyager and Hubble alternatives
entries.finding: The press panel repeats the selected image and Voyager/Hubble are unresolved or nearly unresolved.
entries.revisitWhen: A native registered product adds resolved coverage.

entries.subject: PCK ellipsoid shape model
entries.finding: The explicitly labeled PCK ellipsoid supplies the current approximate geometry and does not establish resolved topography. The separate Stooke/Thomas investigation records why a numerical research mesh was not adopted.

entries.subject: Color, composition, altimetry and geology candidates
entries.finding: The recorded survey found no registered resolved complementary map.
entries.revisitWhen: A mapped product has documented quantity, frame and coverage.

entries.subject: Stooke release and Thomas et al. shape reconstruction
entries.finding: The examined Stooke archive has no Metis model in its released target list. Thomas et al. (1998) and later research describe a reconstruction, but the survey did not locate a reusable numerical release.
entries.revisitWhen: A primary Metis vertex/facet or numerical radius release provides its coordinate frame, units and reconstruction method.

entries.subject: Denk et al. (2026), Figure 10 and Table 3
entries.finding: Image identifiers and comparisons guided the source survey. The paper artwork is not sampled as a texture.
